Content: Before we had refrigeration, people had to dry their foods for long-term storage.  It could have been in a smokehouse or strips of meat on a line, drying in the sun.  Now we have dehydrator machines that can do the same thing in a significantly shorter time and without the flies and birds trying to eat the drying meat or pooping on it.

For the first experiment, we bought 1.6 pounds of bottom round meat at around $12.  It was already cut thinly, and we would have cut it thicker if we had to do it ourselves.  Jerking meat is a little more art than science because the length of time to dry the food depends on your preference.  We like it "al dente," like our bacon:  Cooked but still a little chewy.

ID: Top Notch - Great Design - Easy to Use
Content: We started at 145 for 60 minutes, then 150 for another hour, then 165 for 90 minutes, and the meat was excellent.  Thicker meats will require longer drying times.  It dehydrated to about half its original weight, and we figured that doing it ourselves would cost half what we would have bought at the store.  It could become an expensive treat.

The second experiment was with the spicy apple recipe in the manual.  Since apples are mostly water, this took nine hours, and they are super yummy.  You will need to figure out the drying times based on your personal preference.  The key thing with meat is that it needs to be a lean cut, and the internal temperature reaches (I believe) 165 to kill any bacteria that would form in long-term storage of the jerky.

I backpack a lot and find that commercial meals really add up quickly! I also have wanted a way to better control the ingredients I'm eating. This dehydrator has been phenomenal! It also includes a a solid plastic tray that can either be used to line the bottom of the unit to make clean up easier or to allow you to dry liquid foods. The controls are really easy to use and I love the wide range of temperature settings. The fan is a little loud, but not overwhelming. I'm really pleased with this unit and have been able to get great results so far!

The controls are intuitive, and I'm really impressed with the amount of food I can dry at one time. If I ever need to buy another food dehydrator, this will be the one I purchase.
